claim: The ArrayExpress functional-genomics data collection in BioStudies is an external EMBL-EBI resource storing high-throughput functional-genomics experiment metadata, processed data, raw data links, and reusable study records.
future_grounding_route: Candidate ArrayExpress/BioStudies studies can be downloaded or linked through ENA, hashed, checked for labels/timepoints/module genes, and then processed by project scripts before use.
project_use: Alternative transcriptomic cohort discovery source beyond GEO.
unique_knowledge_lacks_in_repo: EMBL-EBI functional-genomics study records with sample annotations, protocols, processed data, and sequence-read links.
why_unverifiable: ArrayExpress/BioStudies metadata and submitted files are external until a specific study is acquired, hashed, and processed inside this repository.
